limitations: Offline target coverage is an author-scope proxy, not semantic completeness or coding correctness.
No new native model usage, task success, token saving, latency benefit or billed saving exists until an explicitly approved formal execution.
The upstream repositories and intentionally injected defects are controlled workloads; size and source-snapshot coverage are disclosed, not described as representative production work.
Provider and operating-system caches cannot be equivalently reset; order balancing does not establish identical caching.
Native JSONL does not reveal actual billing, underlying inference-call counts, actual filesystem reads or provider CPU/memory.
Native-reported zero cache writes may be a parser default; possible-write sensitivity bounds are scenarios, not confidence intervals.
Budget approval is an estimated API-equivalent allowance, not a guaranteed spend ceiling; Codex exec exposes no hard total-turn token cap here.
All automatic-selection abstentions and failed or interrupted attempts remain in primary intent-to-treat results; originals are never retried.

posthoc_diagnostics.kind: Post-hoc diagnostic, not preregistered task success or policy retuning
limits: Private target labels consulted only after production selection.
Every C run stopped at the weak-evidence gate; later gates were not exercised by this cohort.
Fixed B-then-C offline order, one pass, warm OS caches; timings are descriptive.

gate_diagnosis.cause: Acceptance-criteria prose contributes the denominator while evidence is limited to declaration/path metadata; removing workflow alone would not fix the gate.
gate_diagnosis.downstream_ambiguity_hypothesis: Saturating raw FTS scores give second/first ratios 0.9688..0.9996 for nine multi-candidate tasks; graph exclusion and ambiguity decisions were not reached, so outcomes are unknown.
gate_diagnosis.B_oversized_sources: Three mutated pyproject-hooks implementation bodies are 15758..15821 bytes, exceeding the unchanged 12000-byte complete-file cap.

offline_evaluation.reason: All 12 automatic runs abstained, added no evidence, and incurred observed preparation overhead. Improve on separate development data, then evaluate a fresh held-out cohort before spending on models.

observed_grader_controls.interpretation: External grader/negative-control validation only; not model-generated fixes or native successes.

limitations: external behavioral graders do not execute complete upstream dependency-based suites
corpus.gold_isolation: Private known paths belong only to B preparation and post-preparation diagnostics; hidden grading/reference source never enters C selection. Procedural isolation is not an adversarial sandbox.

memory_router_decision.reason: Current ownership, lifecycle, exact versions and source hashes cannot prove semantic truth, novelty or task usefulness. Caller category verified_fix is not a verification result.
memory_router_decision.passport_caveat: selected_files merges actual source items and memory source references, so inspect delivered bodies/ranges rather than assuming paths prove complete body delivery.
memory_router_decision.next_step: Offline shadow-only single-rule audit; any later paired source-only/single-memory sequence study requires separate frozen protocol and new budget approval.

telemetry.selection_times_and_bytes: Observed in all 24 offline preparations; individual rows preserved.
telemetry.added_token_estimates: Automatic bytes/3 ceiling and excerpt bytes/4 ceiling are explicitly labeled planning proxies
telemetry.native_usage: Future supported native JSONL; unknown categories remain unavailable
telemetry.cached_input: Subset of total input; possible writes must not be silently assumed zero
telemetry.estimated_prices: Observed usage times frozen tariff, including failed-attempt spend; unknown numerator or zero success yields unavailable ratio
telemetry.resources: Sampled child RSS excludes preparation and may miss children/double-count shared pages; parent CPU scope includes instrumentation. Offline preparation omits Git child CPU and peak RSS.

findings: Repoformer trial retrieval still pays retrieval; trained selector speedups do not transfer
RepoCoder sparse/dense completion comparison is not modern coding-agent evidence; iterative generation can add latency and regress
Aider local graph/budget inspiration is not a superiority or completeness proof
Official OpenAI latency guidance separates output/request roundtrips from input shortening; numeric examples are not Memglide predictions

next_experiments: Retain this negative cohort and all 12 weak-evidence abstentions unchanged.
Use separate development data to test repository-aware informative-term weighting and an explicit issue/workflow query boundary; do not tune thresholds on these targets.
Investigate compressed raw-score ambiguity and complete-helper budget behavior as downstream hypotheses; these gates were not reached here.
Measure a generic-query bypass and safe changed-file refresh strategy without replacing live hashing with mtime trust.
Evaluate revised selection on genuinely fresh held-out tasks and larger repositories before asking to spend on a formal native comparison.
Keep automatic memory injection disabled; audit usefulness in shadow mode before a separately approved experiment.
